title: Fix baseline compile error in udpHandler.ino
summary: The current sketch does not compile: main/udpHandler.ino:128 uses LEDS.show() which is undeclared. Replace with FastLED.show(). This is a pre-existing bug blocking all further work.
constraints: Do not change UDP decompression logic

title: Unify LittleFS path addressing (leading slash)
summary: ESP32 version uses '/a.bin' (leading slash) consistently. ESP8266 currently uses 'a.bin' with a binIndex hack in updateCurrentImagesForPattern. Standardize on leading slash everywhere (bin string, exists()/open() calls, upload handler), remove the hack.
constraints: No functional regression in file loading

title: Add pattern file existence cache (backport from ESP32)
summary: Back-port the 62-entry patternFileExistsCache from ESP32: initializePatternFileCache(), refreshPatternFileCacheEntry(), refreshPatternFileCache(), checkPatternFileExists(). Use it in updateCurrentImagesForPattern() to avoid repeated LittleFS.exists() calls which spam framework errors and slow pattern switching.

title: Integrate ElegantOTA for OTA firmware updates
summary: Add ElegantOTA (sync mode, ESP8266WebServer - ESP8266 architecture cannot afford async web server RAM). ElegantOTA.begin(&server) after webServerSetupLogic, ElegantOTA.loop() in loop(), OTA callbacks (onStart/onProgress/onEnd). Requires 4MB flash board with OTA partition scheme. This is the essential feature for updating firmware while sealed in housing.
constraints: ElegantOTA library (3.1.7) installable via Arduino Library Manager

title: Improve background process management (uploadInProgress + pattern save/restore)
summary: Back-port the uploadInProgress flag and pattern save/restore around file operations from ESP32. During uploads: set uploadInProgress=true, save current pattern, set pattern=7 (LEDs off), restore after. loop() should skip LED work while uploadInProgress. Improves upload reliability on single-core ESP8266.
constraints: Single-core ESP8266: no FreeRTOS tasks - use cooperative yield()

title: Load-once image caching in showLittleFSImage
summary: ESP32 version loads the .bin file only when the image char changes (currentLoadedImageChar/fileNeedsReload), instead of reopening every frame like the current ESP8266 code ('Open every time?'). Back-port loadImageData() + markFileForReload() pattern.

title: Web handler parity with ESP32 (patterns 0-70, captive portal, elegant route)
summary: Bring /pattern route validation to 0-70 (currently limited to 62), add captive portal redirects (/generate_204, /hotspot-detect.html, /connectivity-check.html), /elegant route, /poi-available route, and efficient /returnsettings with snprintf buffer (from ESP32 tasks.cpp).
constraints: Keep CORS headers on all routes

title: Add cylonMulticolour pattern 70 and brightness ramp
summary: Back-port cylonMulticolour() + fadeall() from ESP32 ColourPalette.cpp (pattern 70) and the smooth brightness ramp (targetBrightness ramping to newBrightness, BRIGHTNESS_RAMP_INTERVAL/STEP).
constraints: Keep existing palette functions (ESP8266 retains ChangePalettePeriodically2 etc.)

title: Final verification and documentation
summary: Compile full sketch with all upgrades, verify ElegantOTA integration compiles, update README.MD with library requirements (ElegantOTA via Library Manager) and D1 mini 4MB OTA partition instructions. Run full compile check.
constraints: Arduino IDE remains the target toolchain
